# Exposure ascertainment (generated by `python -m polysafe.ascertain`)

PREREGISTRATION section 6, D5.9, D6.2-D6.7. Denominator: the section 6 primary cohort, 671 stays. A stay is exposed when one of its rows counts (D6.4). No AKI label, outcome column or model output was read; the cohort comes from `cohort.build_cohort`.

Every arm and variant is in `results/exposure_prevalence.csv`. For the string arms the `unsure` and `named_only` variants equal `primary` by construction.
